versos.texto_bv: Por causa do rei da Assíria, Acaz alterou no templo do SENHOR a cobertura do sábado que haviam construído no templo e a entrada externa do rei.
versos.traducao_literal: E a cobertura do sábado que construíram na casa e a entrada externa do rei ele fez voltar no templo do SENHOR, por causa do rei da Assíria.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): Verbo “alterou” é semanticamente impreciso para o hebraico que indica remoção/deslocamento, não modificação. — evidência: A literal diz “ele fez voltar” (hiphil de שׁוב — remover/desviar). NTLH: “tirou do Templo… e fechou”; ARA: “retirou da casa do Senhor”; NVIPT: “tirou a cobertura… e retirou a entrada”. As três referências convergem em remoção; BV isolada com “alterou”. Correção exige mudança de sentido (de “modificar” para “remover”) e, portanto, não pode ser feita como edição de forma.

kjv.texto: And the covert for the sabbath that they had built in the house, and the king’s entry without, turned he from the house of the Lord for the king of Assyria.

vizinhos.17: And king Ahaz cut off the borders of the bases, and removed the laver from off them; and took down the sea from off the brasen oxen that were under it, and put it upon a pavement of stones.
vizinhos.19: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

web.texto: The covered way for the Sabbath that they had built in the house, and the king’s entry outside, he turned to Yahweh’s house, because of the king of Assyria.

vizinhos.17: King Ahaz cut off the panels of the bases, and removed the basin from off them, and took down the sea from off the bronze oxen that were under it, and put it on a pavement of stone.
vizinhos.19: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
